scopeLimits: Synthetic 48 kHz microphone and known remote tones; physical devices, acoustic quality, echo and perceived WAN delay require the single human UAT.
One Linux Chrome version; no Safari, Firefox or actual Windows/macOS device qualification.
Live full Manager audio qualification uses standalone/runit; no live systemd audio deployment qualification.
Thirty natural minutes on Australia, not an eight-hour soak or production memory-leak proof.
One Manager per tested browser origin. Multiple Managers behind paths of one origin and cross-origin host bridging are not qualified.
Standalone and cross-tab SDK UAT; actual embedding host embedding/workspace lifecycle remains downstream acceptance.
Audio uses separate WSS. No new display UDP forwarding or transport qualification in this audio run.
PCM16 stereo speaker is 1.536 Mbps per active stream; microphone is 0.768 Mbps once upstream, excluding protocol overhead.
Same-UID domains provide functional routing isolation, not malicious-tenant security.
No merge, release or production acceptance is implied.
